goals: Map every restaurant concept back to Structs and check it is faithful
Run a raid (service challenge) and win it
Find where the skin lies or oversimplifies
persona.readingStyle: Reads everything, including tooltips and the glossary. Notices numbers that do not add up.
persona.skills: Expert mouse/keyboard, hovers for tooltips, checks Settings early.
researchQuestions: Is the mapping consistent everywhere (HUD, sheets, logs, glossary)?
Can an expert execute a deliberate raid strategy (ambit targeting, covers, stealth) through this UI?
Is anything missing that a Structs player would expect (fleet movement, charge visibility, raid timer)?
Would he recommend it to his non-gamer partner?

text: Glossary is the Rosetta stone I wanted. Hustle=Charge, Tick=Block, Cover for=Defend, Blend in=Stealth. Good. But it ends 'Morale / Needs — Heal'?? That should be Health. And there's no Reputation=Planetary Shield, no Fired=Destroyed, and no per-role table (Swing Cook = PDC etc.). Two raids on 'Gently' in ~250 ticks also feels anything but gentle.
Settings > Kitchen glossary pairs 'Morale / Needs' with 'Heal'. In Structs the stat is Health (struct HP); 'Heal' reads like an action. Expected 'Health'.

args: Settings > Kitchen glossary pairs 'Morale / Needs' with 'Heal'. In Structs the stat is Health (struct HP); 'Heal' reads like an action. Expected 'Health'.

text: Deliberate pick this time: Snug Skillet Bakehouse — 11 recipes, 0 rep (no shield), crew OUT. Classic Structs move: hit the planet while its fleet is away. Host is blending in, Manager on the Line.

events.text: Send the crew
Your crew walks into Snug Skillet Bakehouse as customers. Complain until you can copy their recipes — and keep your Food Critic unsatisfied!
Table Hopper

text: Sent the crew while my Manager was at 2/6 morale from an earlier defence; the Food Critic arrived already '4/6 satisfied' and was knocked out within ~30 ticks, ending the raid. There is no way I found to restore Manager morale, and 'Send the crew' gave no warning about the Critic's state. Expected either recovery over time / a rest action, or a pre-raid readiness check showing Critic morale.

text: Deliberate raid, right target, right timing — undone by a Critic I couldn't heal and customers I couldn't click.

Correction for the record: in the Crumb raid I did get a 'Customers incoming!' speech bubble. So there IS a warning, it's just a transient bubble I never saw in the first raid — still too easy to miss for something that costs all your recipes.

oneSentence: The most faithful translation of Structs I have seen — the weapon cards, stealth, charge and command-ship rules all survive — but the raid UI hides the attackers behind the menu bar and the raid outcome is mostly a timer, so tactics barely matter yet.
favoriteMoment: Reading the Cocktail Snob card (Battleship: unguided to Line/Dish, guided to Bar, Smooth Talker evasion) and moving my Manager to the Cooking Line and watching its reach change to Line.
worstMoment: Losing all my recipes to three raids on Gently, and in my own deliberate raid losing because the Critic started at 2/6 morale and I could not click my own customers stacked behind the menu bar.
quitPoint: Third raid (Wren) copying all 10 recipes I had just won, discovered only via the result popup.
confusions: Did my queued Serve/Complain ever fire? Hustle never reset and the log never said.
Challenge log calls equipment by staff names (Pretzel the Soft-Serve Machine).
Name tag says Satisfied but panel says Needs met 0/3.
wishlist: List of visiting customers / attackers in the challenge banner as click targets
Way to see a rival roster (roles, areas, morale) when sizing them up
Manager/Critic morale recovery or readiness check before sending the crew
Full role-to-struct table in the glossary
